explanation: Put the first available entry from each sorted array into a min-heap. Repeatedly extract the smallest and replace it with the next entry from the same iterator.
timeComplexity: O(N log(k+1)), for N entries across k arrays
spaceComplexity: O(k) working space plus O(N) output
